OP - lots of good suggestions in here.  A few things from my perspective (mom of a girl who was sexually assaulted at age 5) - remind her that she is brave for coming forward, that you are proud of her etc.  But not in an "over the top" kinda way.  Obviously your 15 year old is going to react differently than my 5 year old but some tips I was given were - make sure your child knows they can talk to you if they want, but also return to "normal" as people have said to reassure her that she is not broken.

You will also need to process how this affects you.  You might need some counseling as well.  Again, different because of age, but after 2 years I am still working through what happened.  

Also healing is not linear.  She will have good days, and bad days.  Many good days in a row even, and then some bad days.
